title: About
lead: Vnua Apparel is the store for Vnua Industries, my company.
body:
Club merch

I'm president of SHPE and co-president of AIAA at Hofstra. Club merch usually means someone fronts the money for a box of shirts in sizes nobody wanted. Preorders fix that. Members vote, people order what they'll actually wear, and the club keeps what it raises.

The grid

Vnua comes from the letters of my last name, Ventura. I came up with it in eighth grade. The mark is a 3×3 grid, like one face of a puzzle cube. Drop 01 gives each piece one of the cube's six colors.

Who's behind it

I'm Adriel Ventura, a mechanical engineering student at Hofstra. The rest of what I'm building is on Vnua Systems.
